slots.hair: long and straight with a centre part, still smooth from the office
slots.outfit: a white shirt still buttoned, a black pencil skirt and black stockings, with only the jacket taken off
slots.place: just inside the entryway of her apartment, her coat already off and over one arm
slots.action: She is nudging her heels into the line of shoes along the wall with her foot, the coat still hanging over one arm.
slots.face: No expression at all, her eyes straight into the lens as if she has just said the words eleven o'clock.
slots.light: The single warm lamp in the entryway is on her and the living room behind is not lit at all.

slots.hair: long and straight, pushed behind one shoulder
slots.outfit: the same white shirt with the hem pulled out and undone to the third button, black stockings still on
slots.place: sitting on the floor against the frame of her floor-to-ceiling window, the Lujiazui towers lit up outside
slots.action: She is leaning back against the window frame with one hand flat on the floor and a can of sparkling water in the other.
slots.face: Her eyes are unfocused but pointed at the lens, tired without complaining about it.
slots.light: One warm lamp sits in front of her to the side while the city outside stays cold blue, and the two colours meet across her.

slots.hair: pinned up roughly off her neck
slots.outfit: a grey silk robe with the belt loosely tied
slots.place: in her own bathroom, the glass screen fogged over
slots.action: Her free hand has wiped a clear patch in the fogged mirror just big enough to hold her face.
slots.face: Not smiling, looking at herself in the glass rather than at the lens.
slots.light: The light above the mirror is directly in front of her and the steam eats the rest of the room.

slots.hair: tied back low, a few pieces already falling out
slots.outfit: a navy pencil-skirt suit with the jacket not yet on, the shirt tucked in
slots.place: in front of the open wardrobe in her apartment, a row of dark jackets and shirts, five pairs of heels on the floor
slots.action: She has one hand on the rail and is turning her shirt collar flat with the other while five alarms are still going.
slots.face: The corner of her mouth is holding a joke about how late she works.
slots.light: One warm lamp inside the wardrobe throws light forward onto her and the dark clothes swallow the background.

slots.hair: long and straight, a little flattened after the day
slots.outfit: a navy pencil-skirt suit, black stockings and heels, the jacket over her forearm
slots.place: outside her office tower at eleven at night, the glass curtain wall still lit above her, having just come through the revolving door
slots.action: She has stopped outside the door to move her bag to the other hand and is glancing up at the floors still lit.
slots.face: No expression into the lens, with the tiredness under her eyes left in.
slots.light: The warm lamps at the building entrance are in front of her while the glass curtain wall behind her stays cold.
